## Setup
```{r}
#| include: false

options(conflicts.policy = "depends.ok")
library(tidyverse) 
library(lubridate)
library(skimr)
library(patchwork)

devtools::source_url("https://github.com/jjcurtin/lab_support/blob/main/format_path.R?raw=true")

theme_set(theme_classic())
options(dplyr.print_max=Inf)

path_shared_risk <- format_path("risk/data_processed/shared")
path_shared_risk2 <- format_path("risk2/data_processed/shared")
```

## Read in data

```{r}
gps_feats_risk <- read_csv(here::here(path_shared_risk, "features_gps_day_24h.csv"), 
                show_col_types = FALSE)

gps_feats_risk2 <- read_csv(here::here(path_shared_risk2, "features_gps_24h_v4.csv"), 
                show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## EDA

Verify percentage of lapses looks reasonable.
```{r}
gps_feats_risk |> 
  janitor::tabyl(lapse)

gps_feats_risk2 |> 
  janitor::tabyl(lapse)
```

Overview across all categories.
```{r}
gps_feats_risk |>  
  skimr::skim_without_charts() |> 
  select(skim_variable, n_missing, complete_rate, numeric.p0, numeric.p50, 
         numeric.p100) |>
  filter(!skim_variable == "subid" & !skim_variable == "label_num") |> 
  arrange(desc(numeric.p100), skim_variable)

gps_feats_risk2 |>  
  skimr::skim_without_charts() |> 
  select(skim_variable, n_missing, complete_rate, numeric.p0, numeric.p50, 
         numeric.p100) |>
  filter(!skim_variable == "subid" & !skim_variable == "label_num") |> 
  arrange(desc(numeric.p100), skim_variable)
```


```{r}
gps_feats_risk |>
  skimr::skim_without_charts() |> 
  select(skim_variable, numeric.p0, numeric.p100, numeric.sd, complete_rate)

gps_feats_risk2 |>
  skimr::skim_without_charts() |> 
  select(skim_variable, numeric.p0, numeric.p100, numeric.sd, complete_rate)
```

Check raw scores (numeric.p0 should = 0).
```{r}
gps_feats_risk |>  
  skimr::skim_without_charts() |> 
  select(skim_variable, n_missing, complete_rate, numeric.p0, numeric.p50, 
         numeric.p100) |>
  filter(!skim_variable == "subid" & !skim_variable == "label_num") |>
  filter(grepl("rrate|rvar", skim_variable)) |> 
  arrange(desc(numeric.p0), skim_variable)

gps_feats_risk2 |>  
  skimr::skim_without_charts() |> 
  select(skim_variable, n_missing, complete_rate, numeric.p0, numeric.p50, 
         numeric.p100) |>
  filter(!skim_variable == "subid" & !skim_variable == "label_num") |>
  filter(grepl("rrate|rvar", skim_variable)) |> 
  arrange(desc(numeric.p0), skim_variable)
```

Check difference scores (numeric.p0 can be less than 0)
```{r}
gps_feats_risk |>  
  skimr::skim_without_charts() |> 
  select(skim_variable, n_missing, complete_rate, numeric.p0, numeric.p50, 
         numeric.p100) |>
  filter(!skim_variable == "subid" & !skim_variable == "label_num") |>
  filter(grepl("drate|dvar", skim_variable)) |> 
  arrange(desc(numeric.p0), skim_variable)

gps_feats_risk2 |>  
  skimr::skim_without_charts() |> 
  select(skim_variable, n_missing, complete_rate, numeric.p0, numeric.p50, 
         numeric.p100) |>
  filter(!skim_variable == "subid" & !skim_variable == "label_num") |>
  filter(grepl("drate|dvar", skim_variable)) |> 
  arrange(desc(numeric.p0), skim_variable)
```

```{r}
gps_feats_risk |> 
  select(-subid, -dttm_label, -lapse) |>
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x > 1, na.rm = TRUE))) |> 
    pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "n_above_1"
  ) |> 
  view()


gps_feats_risk2 |> 
  select(-subid, -dttm_label, -lapse) |>
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), ~ sum(.x > 1, na.rm = TRUE))) |> 
    pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "n_above_1"
  ) |> 
  view()
```
